variables.name: query_log
variables.label: Query log table
variables.description: Fully qualified query_log source. Point it at a premade view (for example obs_tools.query_log) to read a cluster-wide or rotation-aware query log instead of the local system table.

variables.name: query_kind
variables.label: Query kind
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT(query_kind) as query_kind FROM ${query_log} WHERE query_kind != ''

variables.name: type
variables.label: Query status
variables.query: SELECT type FROM ${query_log} GROUP BY type

variables.name: user
variables.label: User
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT(initial_user) FROM ${query_log} WHERE initial_user != '' LIMIT 100

queries.query:
SELECT count() as "Total queries"
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

SELECT
  avg(memory_usage) as "Avg query memory",
  $__timeInterval(query_start_time) as time
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT query_duration_ms as "Query time"
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  initial_user,
  count() as c
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY initial_user
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  avg(query_duration_ms) as "Avg query time",
  $__timeInterval(query_start_time) as time
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(query_start_time) as time,
  any(normalizeQuery(query)) AS normalized_query,
  count() as c
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE type != 'QueryStart'
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND normalized_query_hash IN (
    SELECT normalized_query_hash
    FROM ${query_log}
    WHERE
      $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
      AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
      AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
      AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
    GROUP BY normalized_query_hash
    ORDER BY count() DESC
    LIMIT 5
  )
GROUP BY normalized_query_hash, time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Query performance by type over time

queries.query:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(query_start_time) as time,
  any(normalizeQuery(query)) AS normalized_query,
  avg(query_duration_ms) as avg_query_duration
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE type != 'QueryStart'
  AND $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND normalized_query_hash IN (
    SELECT normalized_query_hash
    FROM ${query_log}
    WHERE
      $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
      AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
      AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
      AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
    GROUP BY normalized_query_hash
    ORDER BY avg(query_duration_ms) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
GROUP BY normalized_query_hash, time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(query_start_time) as time,
  initial_user as user,
  count() as "number of queries by"
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND initial_user IN (
    SELECT initial_user
    FROM ${query_log}
    WHERE
      $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
      AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
      AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
    GROUP BY initial_user
    ORDER BY count() DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
GROUP BY initial_user, time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(query_start_time) as time,
  max(memory_usage) as "Max Memory Usage"
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(event_time) as time,
  sum(read_rows) read_rows,
  sum(written_rows) written_rows
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT
  query_start_time,
  type,
  query_duration_ms,
  initial_user,
  substring(query_id, 1, 8) as query_id,
  query_kind,
  normalizeQuery(query) AS normalized_query,
  concat(toString(read_rows), ' rows / ', formatReadableSize(read_bytes)) AS read,
  concat(toString(written_rows), ' rows / ', formatReadableSize(written_bytes)) AS written,
  concat(toString(result_rows), ' rows / ', formatReadableSize(result_bytes)) AS result,
  memory_usage
FROM ${query_log}
WHERE
  $__conditionalAll(type IN (${type:singlequote}), $type)
  AND $__conditionalAll(initial_user IN (${user:singlequote}), $user)
  AND $__conditionalAll(query_kind IN (${query_kind:singlequote}), $query_kind)
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
ORDER BY query_duration_ms DESC
LIMIT 1000
